name: Zeblaze GTS 3 Calling Smartwatch (Black)
description:
Zeblaze GTS 3 Calling Smartwatch (Black)

Brand: Zeblaze
Model: GTS 3

Key Features

Ultra-large 2.03" IPS Touch Display (240 × 296px, 260 PPI)

Bluetooth Phone Calling support

100+ Stylish Watch Faces

100+ Professional Sports Modes

Ultra-long Battery Life:

Typical usage: up to 15 days

Heavy usage: up to 7 days

Continuous voice calling: up to 325 mins

Fast Charging: 1.5 hours only

Health Monitoring Sensors:

Wrist heart rate monitor

Blood oxygen (SpO₂) monitor

Proximity sensor

Accelerometer

Lightweight & Stylish design (only 35.5g with strap)

Build & Materials

Case Material: Plastic

Button Material: Alloy

Buckle Material: Plastic

Strap: Durable & comfortable fluoroelastomer (22mm, quick-release, fits 130–235mm wrist)

Specifications

Bluetooth Version: BLE 5.2

Compatibility: Android 5.0 / iOS 9.0 and above

Dimensions: 47 × 38 × 11mm

Weight: 35.5g (20.7g without strap)

Battery: 280mAh Li-Polymer

What's in the Box

1 × Zeblaze GTS 3 Calling Smartwatch (Black)

1 × Charger Cable

1 × User Guide

✅ 6 Months Official Warranty
